content_of_post_to_answer: What are some tips for staying focused and comfortable during extended meditation sessions?
answer: Long meditation sessions become difficult when you treat every distraction or ache as something to overcome. Separate ordinary restlessness from genuine physical discomfort: gently adjust your posture when needed, but notice the urge to fidget before acting on it. Use shorter periods of focused attention followed by brief body scans. I've explored this relationship between attention and discomfort in more detail on my Quora profile. The goal isn't to sit perfectly still; it's to notice without automatically reacting.
